scenarios.title: A compleated planeswalker enters with two fewer loyalty counters per symbol paid with life
decisions: A casts Vraska, Betrayal's Sting, paying 2 life for the {B/P} symbol and {4}{B} with five Swamps.

variants.label: paid_life
variants.expected: A's life is 18. Vraska enters the battlefield with 4 loyalty counters (6 minus 2). One Swamp stays untapped.

variants.label: paid_mana
variants.delta: A pays {B} for the {B/P} symbol with a sixth Swamp instead of paying 2 life.
variants.expected: A's life stays 20. Vraska enters the battlefield with 6 loyalty counters.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: a different payment, mana instead of life for the Phyrexian symbol

detector.outcome: A permanent entering the battlefield meets a replacement that changes how it enters (such as entering with fewer loyalty counters) and the handler reports updated.
detector.near_miss: Such a replacement meets an entering permanent and leaves the event as it was.
